scenario: Payments: 'I invoiced 45 days ago and haven't been paid' (Block 1)
subject: Summer Glow invoice - still unpaid

messages.body:
Hi Imogen,

I invoiced Quillmoss for the Summer Glow video on August 21 - that's 45 days ago now, and your terms are net 30. I still haven't received anything.

Could you look into it? This is the first time I've had an issue with you guys, so I'm assuming something just got stuck somewhere.

Thanks,
Danielle
